repairs.quote: K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for 0.4-1.0s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by 30%. Then, he rams forward, dealing 45/75/105/135/165 + (8% + (2% per 100 bonus Armor) + (2% per 100 bonus Magic Resist)) max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for 0.5-1.75s (based on charge time). All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional 10-80% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to 75% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns. Maximum effect is reached at 90% charge time. Maximum of 180/260/340/420/500 damage against monsters.
